values.note: Wooded, secluded sites best suited to tents and small trailers/RVs; the FS says vehicles 25 ft or less work best. One RV (or two vehicles) per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hayden-creek-campground ('The campground is small with only 11 sites'; 'Maximum length for RVs is 30 feet'; 'Vehicles 25 feet or less work best in the area'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Bring all water. Trash service may not be available before Memorial Day weekend or after Labor Day.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hayden-creek-campground ('Restrooms: Vault toilet'; 'Potable water is not available at this site'; 'Prior to Memorial Day weekend and after Labor Day, trash service may not be available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: May to September; opening and closing dates are weather dependent (recreation.gov's 2026 pay season ran May 15 - Oct 11).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hayden-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + recreation.gov /rates (2026 First-come season 2026-05-15 to 10-11), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Claim a site in person; pay at the self-service fee tube (cash, check or money order) or with recreation.gov Scan & Pay.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/hayden-creek-campground ('This campground is strictly first come, first served'; 'A self-service fee tube is available for on-site payment') + recreation.gov 10165355 overview (Scan and Pay), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165355/rates (2026 First-come season WalkInScanPay1 22) + FS page ('$22 per site for overnight camping ... $10 fee for a third vehicle'), read 2026-10-28

note: Pike-San Isabel NF campground on Hayden Creek at the base of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains, 5 mi up County Road 6 from US 50 at Coaldale (past Cutty's private campground). Bear-resistant food storage is required. --Claude
